body:
Being bored and out of weed, I decided to try something. I took a dried whole sage leaf, scraped the resin out of my bowl, and put it on the leaf. I smoked the whole thing and the smoke tasted pretty good, but it hurt my throat after a while. Right now (I smoked this about 15 minutes ago) I feel a little bit stoned, but my body feels heavier and I feel more 'cleansed' than if I had smoked weed. My head is light but it feels really heavy at the same time, like my neck can't support it. These effects are very mild and I feel overall grounded and relaxed. Also, it's kinda hard to concentrate on typing and I keep getting distracted. My throat is tickling and I am starting to get a headache.
All in all, the effects are ok, but I probably won't be smoking sage again.
